text: In that day you will say: “I will praise you, O Lord. Although you were angry with me, your anger has turned away and you have comforted me.
I will trust and not be afraid. The Lord, the Lord, is my strength and my song; he has become my salvation.”
“Give thanks to the Lord, call on his name; make known among the nations what he has done, and proclaim that his name is exalted.
let this be known to all the world.
for great is the Holy One of Israel among you.”
